description: Upstream normal/nuisance labels are preserved as the basis. Explicit reaction-context comments are separated into reactive. normal->direct_nuisance is never automatic in compatibility mode.

reactive_matching.note: This intentionally mirrors the documented first-pass mechanism. Normalization may be used later for filter-keyword analysis, but not for compatibility labeling.

review_priorities.1: Likely missed reactive context; mandatory adjudication for strict finalization.
review_priorities.2: Potential upstream normal/nuisance boundary issue; informative unless a full relabel is explicitly authorized.

historical_reference.known_gap: The prior run contained 41 normal-candidate exclusions and 1 nuisance-candidate exclusion whose complete exception code was not recoverable. Do not fabricate those exceptions. Resolve ambiguous cases through the review workflow.
